notes: Quarter system. Domestic application fee is $135; international application fee is $155.

app_fee.value: Application fee is $135.00 for domestic applicants and $155.00 for international applicants.
app_fee.quote: The application fee is $135.00 for domestic applicants and $155.00 for international applicants. Electronic payment options are available through our application system; a small fee (approximately $4) will also be charged for credit card processing.

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers are available for US Citizens, AB 540, or Permanent Residents with financial hardship, but are extremely limited.
fee_waiver.quote: If you are a US Citizen, AB 540, or Permanent Resident of the United States, you may request an application fee waiver if you believe you are eligible. Please be aware that fee waivers are extremely limited.

gre_general.value: GRE requirements vary by program; applicants should check specific program requirements.
gre_general.quote: GRE requirements vary by program; applicants whose native language is not English may be required to take the TOEFL iBT (including the Home Edition) or IELTS Academic exam.

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT score is 83 for general programs, though select STEM programs require 89.

ielts_min.value: A minimum overall band score of 7 from the IELTS test is required for admission.
ielts_min.quote: For those choosing to take the IELTS Academic (in-person and online versions), a minimum overall score of 7 from the IELTS test is required for admission.

english_waiver.value: Waivers for admission purposes may be requested by applicants who completed a 4-year bachelor's degree at an English-speaking institution.
english_waiver.quote: TOEFL/IELTS waivers for admission purposes may be requested by applicants who do not have English as their first language and who have completed a four-year bachelor’s degree at an English-speaking institution.
